ESV Digital Brazil.status_citation: https://brasilapi.com.br/api/cnpj/v1/17466851000127 (Receita Federal record for ESV DIGITAL AGENCIA DE PUBLICIDADE LTDA., trade name ESVBR, CNPJ 17.466.851/0001-27, Sao Paulo/SP: situacao cadastral INAPTA since 2022-06-07, motivo 'OMISSAO DE DECLARACOES'; same in https://publica.cnpj.ws/cnpj/17466851000127). Supporting: esvdigital.com.br redirected to esvbr.com in Jan 2019 (http://web.archive.org/web/20190108030102id_/http://www.esvdigital.com.br:80/); the ESVBR site's newest post is April 2018 and its last capture is Sep 2019 (http://web.archive.org/web/20190929195903id_/https://www.esvbr.com/); by Jan 2022 the ESV group site listed only US/FR/UK (http://web.archive.org/web/20220104125353id_/https://www.esvdigital.com/); esvbr.com is now a HugeDomains sale page.
ESV Digital Brazil.entry_citation: No source names a round. Project A's own archived portfolio page lists 'Investment: Joint Venture', Location Sao Paulo (http://web.archive.org/web/20170621130520id_/https://www.project-a.com/en/portfolio/esv-digital-brazil); press describes a partnership with Project A and a R$2M investment, with no round name (https://startupi.com.br/2014/02/com-investimento-de-r-2-milhoes-agencia-digital-esv-chega-ao-brasil/, https://www.baguete.com.br/noticias/11/02/2014/esv-chega-ao-brasil-com-project-a).
ESV Digital Brazil.notes: The Brazilian entity opened 2013-01-07 (CNPJ record) and launched publicly in Jan/Feb 2014 as a JV between ESV Digital (Paris) and Project A; it merged with RTB agency Adtrade in June 2014. It rebranded as ESVBR (esvbr.com) in 2018/2019. Since 2016-04-29 the registered shareholder has been ESV DIGITAL BRAZIL SPRL (Belgium), with an administrator added in 2019. I found no acquisition. 'Defunct' rests on the INAPTA tax status (failure to file returns) plus the dead web presence, not on a closure announcement. The ESV parent's esvdigital.com redirected to bell-digitalmarketing.com in Nov 2022 and is now parked.

Investment: Seed' (http://web.archive.org/web/20161230084651id_/https://www.project-a.com/de/portfolio/natue). Timing: Diario do Comercio (11 Mar 2015) says Natue got its 'primeiro aporte' from Project A within a month of starting its business plan in Sep 2012, and the site went live in Dec 2012 (http://web.archive.org/web/20251011050546id_/https://www.dcomercio.com.br/publicacao/s/pequenas-inovadoras-a-pegada-saudavel-da-natue-).
Natue.graduation_citation: https://www.lavca.org/natue-backed-by-project-a-ventures-announces-new-investment-deal/ (11 Jun 2013: new round of US$8M / R$16M from Alstin and Lakestar; Natue 'has already been backed by Project A Ventures'); https://exame.com/pme/natue-recebe-aporte-de-r-16-mi-para-alavancar-negocio/ (calls it Natue's second round).
Natue.notes: LOW CONFIDENCE ON GRADUATION. The June 2013 round is unnamed and US$8M, which clears the $5M floor. The Project A seed amount was never disclosed, so the 'at least twice the seed' test is inferred, not shown. It is inferred from a two-founder company that launched in Dec 2012 on Project A's first check, raising $8M five months later. LAVCA says the 2013 money went into Nu3, 'of which Natue forms part', and Project A's 2016 page says 'natue ist Teil der nu3 GmbH'. I found no named Series A or later round. If the 2x test is treated as unproven, the answer would be not_graduated (seed Oct 2012, far past 24 months).

Tabular.status_citation: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/tabula (Status: Active, Summer 2024, Berlin, team 13); https://tabula.de/impressum (Tabula GmbH, Sophienstrasse 5, 10178 Berlin, HRB 263614 B, updated 16.7.2026); no acquisition found.
Tabular.entry_citation: Project A's portfolio page, Tabular row: 'Entry stage: Pre-Seed', HQ Berlin (https://www.project-a.vc/companies). CONFLICT: the company says 'We've raised a $4.7M Seed with YC, LocalGlobe, Rerail and Project A.' (https://tabula.de/en/jobs; the YC job post https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/tabula/jobs/7IrlsEN-founding-account-executive says '$4.7m Seed round from LocalGlobe').
Tabular.notes: I took Pre-Seed from the investor's own entry-stage label. Two reasons: the company's '$4.7M Seed' is a total that also folds in YC's programme check, and Project A's labels matched the press on the other five companies where both exist. If the Seed reading is preferred, the graduation would be borderline. The seed is not in the Aug 20, 2024 YC page capture but is in the Nov 2, 2024 capture ('seed-stage startup and have raised $4.6m by investors like Y Combinator and LocalGlobe'), so it closed between Aug 20 and Nov 2, 2024. I found no later round. That gives censored if the close was after 2024-09-30 and not_graduated if before; the date is not published. The name changed from Tabular to Tabula in 2025/2026, and Project A's page still says Tabular (with Founded 2021, which contradicts YC's 2024).
